text: Debugging is an essential skill for every programmer. When you find that your program is not working correctly, the first step is identifying bugs by carefully reading error messages and testing different parts of the code. Good debugging tools, such as breakpoints and step-by-step execution, help you find exactly where problems happen. A systematic approach is important: change one thing at a time, test your code after each change, and keep notes about what you have tried. Logging is also a powerful strategy. By adding log messages to your code, you can see what the program is doing and spot where things go wrong. With patience and the right methods, you can solve most bugs efficiently.
